description: Phase 3+4: All service classes, Pundit policy, REST serializers, notification types, and the counter reconciliation worker. This implements all backend business logic.
steps: Create app/services/create_occm_group_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(account, params) wraps in transaction: creates OccmGroup, creates admin membership (role: :admin, state: :active), sets member_count to 1

Create app/services/join_occm_group_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(account, occm_group): checks not already member/pending, if approval_required creates pending membership and notifies admins/mods, if not creates active membership and increments member_count

Create app/services/approve_occm_group_member_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, account_id): finds pending membership, updates state to active, increments member_count, notifies requester with occm_group_join_approved

Create app/services/reject_occm_group_member_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, account_id): finds pending membership, updates state to rejected, notifies requester with occm_group_join_rejected

Create app/services/remove_occm_group_member_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, account_id, current_account): raises error if target is admin, destroys membership, decrements member_count, publishes revoke event to streaming channel

Create app/services/transfer_occm_group_admin_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, target_account_id): verifies target is active member, wraps in transaction with lock!, swaps roles (target becomes admin, former admin becomes user), updates occm_group.account_id

Create app/services/post_to_occm_group_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(account, occm_group, params): verifies active membership, calls PostStatusService with visibility: :limited and local_only: true, creates OccmGroupStatus record, calls DistributeOccmGroupStatusService

Create app/services/distribute_occm_group_status_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(status, occm_group): renders status via InlineRenderer, publishes to Redis channel timeline:occm_group:{id} with event :update

Create app/services/delete_occm_group_status_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, status, current_account): removes OccmGroupStatus record, removes underlying Status, notifies post author with occm_group_post_deleted, publishes delete event to streaming channel

Create app/services/resolve_occm_group_report_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(occm_group, report, action, current_account): sets action_taken_at/action_taken_by_account_id, if action is delete_posts calls DeleteOccmGroupStatusService for each status, if remove_member calls RemoveOccmGroupMemberService

Create app/services/notify_occm_group_service.rb - inherits BaseService, call(recipient, type, activity): creates Notification record, renders via InlineRenderer, publishes to Redis timeline:{recipient.id}, handles all 4 notification types

Create app/workers/occm_group_counter_reconciliation_worker.rb - include Sidekiq::Worker, queue scheduler, retry 0, find_each batch_size 200, compares member_count to actual active count, uses update_column when different

Create app/policies/occm_group_policy.rb - inherits ApplicationPolicy, methods: update? (admin only), destroy? (admin only), moderate? (admin or moderator), transfer? (admin only), post? (any active member), show? (any active member). Memoize membership lookup

Create app/serializers/rest/occm_group_serializer.rb - attributes: id (to_s), title, description, approval_required, member_count, role, membership_state, created_at. Support memberships_map option for N+1 prevention
Create app/serializers/rest/occm_group_membership_serializer.rb - attributes: id (to_s), role, state, created_at. Has one :account using REST::AccountSerializer

Create app/serializers/rest/occm_group_report_serializer.rb - attributes: id (to_s), occm_group_id (to_s), status_ids, comment, category, action_taken_at, created_at. Has one :account, :target_account, :action_taken_by_account

Modify app/models/notification.rb - add 4 new types to PROPERTIES hash: occm_group_join_request (filterable:true, baseline:false), occm_group_join_approved, occm_group_join_rejected, occm_group_post_deleted. Add belongs_to :occm_group_membership with foreign_key activity_id optional
acceptance_criteria: All service files load without syntax errors
CreateOccmGroupService creates group and admin membership in a single transaction
JoinOccmGroupService handles both approval_required=true and false cases correctly
TransferOccmGroupAdminService atomically swaps roles with row locking
PostToOccmGroupService creates limited-visibility local-only status and links to group
DistributeOccmGroupStatusService publishes to correct Redis channel
OccmGroupPolicy returns correct boolean for each role/action combination
Serializers output correct JSON structure with string IDs
Notification types are properly registered and the model validates them
verification: Run: ruby -c on all new Ruby files to verify syntax
Verify notification types are in the TYPES constant by checking the PROPERTIES hash includes all 4 new types
findings: All 17 files pass rubocop with no offenses. Used defined?(@membership) pattern instead of ||= for find_by memoization per Rails/FindByOrAssignmentMemoization cop. Combined duplicate case branches in notify service per Lint/DuplicateBranch cop. Worker uses queue 'pull' (no 'scheduler' queue exists in Mastodon). Full Rails environment cannot load without libvips (not available in sandbox) so verification is limited to syntax checks and rubocop.
